---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md"
---

# Documentation

- Write in plain, direct English. Short paragraphs, tables for comparisons, code blocks for commands and config.
- Use project vocabulary exactly: Conductor, Mini-conductor, Worker, Adapter, Escalation, Decision, HandoffPacket, Task.
- Any claim about a vendor, protocol, price or term needs a source link and should say when it was checked. Paraphrase sources; do not paste long quotes.
- Keep `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` describing the current intended design. When an ADR changes it, update it and link the ADR.
- `README.md` stays short: pitch, status, links. Put depth in `docs/`.
